methodology.description: Subgroup metrics are calculated with the canonical ClaimFast analyze_records() evaluator.
methodology.record_exact_match: Strict equality across all nine output fields.
methodology.run_handling: Each subgroup contains the same test messages evaluated under five strategies and three runs. Run statistics are calculated across run-level metrics.
methodology.limitations: Subgroup results are diagnostic. In particular, the multi-incident subgroup contains only one message and must not be treated as generalisable evidence.

reliability.gold_null_overprediction_rate_definition: Predicted non-null extraction values where the gold value is null, divided by all predicted non-null extraction values. This measures overprediction against the gold labels; it is not a source-grounded hallucination rate. Wrong values where gold is non-null are reported separately as incorrect non-null extractions.

cost_estimate_usd.note: Supply both input and output token prices to calculate cost. Prices are intentionally not hard-coded.

run_agreement.definition: Pairwise agreement between parsed prediction objects for the same strategy and record across different runs. API and parse failures are excluded from agreement comparisons and remain counted in reliability rates.

metric_definitions.macro_average: Unweighted mean across every allowed class in the schema.
metric_definitions.invalid_classification_prediction: Missing or out-of-schema predicted classification values are counted as invalid predictions and as false negatives for the gold class.
metric_definitions.extraction_null_semantics: Null means not extracted/unknown; false is a populated boolean value. Wrong non-null extractions count as both a false positive and a false negative.
metric_definitions.record_exact_match: All nine predicted fields must exactly equal the gold object.
metric_definitions.run_agreement: Pairwise agreement between parsed predictions for the same strategy and record across runs.

run_agreement.definition: Pairwise agreement between parsed prediction objects for the same strategy and record across different runs. API and parse failures are excluded from agreement comparisons and remain counted in reliability rates.

metric_definitions.macro_average: Unweighted mean across every allowed class in the schema.
metric_definitions.invalid_classification_prediction: Missing or out-of-schema predicted classification values are counted as invalid predictions and as false negatives for the gold class.
metric_definitions.extraction_null_semantics: Null means not extracted/unknown; false is a populated boolean value. Wrong non-null extractions count as both a false positive and a false negative.
metric_definitions.record_exact_match: All nine predicted fields must exactly equal the gold object.
metric_definitions.run_agreement: Pairwise agreement between parsed predictions for the same strategy and record across runs.
